## Not verified

- T1566.001 (mail attachment) is tagged only for a mark whose quarantine agent is `Mail` (Apple Mail). That string is the **expected** one and is **not yet captured**: no `com.apple.quarantine` value from a saved Mail attachment is in the repo, and if a Mac shows another string the tag does not fire. Outlook is **not verified** either. Hypothesis: the opened attachment is copied under the `Content.Outlook` folder; whether it carries a mark, and which process writes it, is still to be observed. Thunderbird is not verified. Neither is in the rule until a lab capture shows the mark and its writer (https://github.com/synthaea-lab/agent/issues/17).
- T1204.002 on Linux joins a browser download through the rename of its partial file (`.crdownload`, `.opdownload`, `.part`), by the renaming process's `executable_path`; verified once, on a Fedora 43 lab VM (Chromium 156, Firefox 159, Chrome 157, Edge, Brave 1.99, Opera, Vivaldi 8.3, headed under Xvfb, profile without a download dialog). **Not verified:** Firefox ESR and other distributions' image paths until captured, so they raise nothing; Flatpak and Snap installs (other image paths); a Wayland session; a download through a Save-as dialog; a same-device Chromium rename (the capture's `/tmp` rename failed with `EXDEV`); a download resumed after a restart. An empty `executable_path` marks nothing: the process-lineage fallback is not implemented, and the capture ran under `strace` so its lineage was not real (https://github.com/synthaea-lab/agent/issues/221).
